purpose: Point-in-time metadata resolution for historical market-surveillance research; no trading outputs.

announcement_exclusion_receipt.downstream_policy: Excluded events retain blank public_announcement_ts and information_asymmetry_seconds and may not participate in announcement-timing-dependent analysis.

shares_exclusion_receipt.downstream_policy: Excluded symbol-dates remain blank, are marked excluded_fail_closed, and may not contribute shares outstanding or turnover.

control_exclusion_receipt.downstream_policy: Excluded event dates retain zero candidate counts, are marked excluded_fail_closed, and may not contribute matched controls or model-evaluation authorization.
